description: Queries retain both recognized tag sets. A flag changes selection without removing the rival from the query union (engine §4.1 and §10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution leftmost-longest #·a, greedy
%rule text $x:A %conditions $x.parse(q).tags = (Tag-a ∪ Tag-b), $x.parse(q), $x.parse(q …)

%rule q a | b
%rule a :: Tag-a | A
               

%rule b :: Tag-b | A
